data.explanation: This is an invoice from a chimney technician for renovation work on your chimney. You should pay the total amount by the deadline shown, which the app calculates from the invoice date. If you don't pay in time, the company could send reminders and eventually charge late-payment interest or pursue collection. Keep this invoice, as craftsman's labour costs (Handwerkerleistungen) can often be partly deducted in your German tax return — consider checking with a tax advisor or using the official guidance when filing.
